map.总利息=月供×期数−本金。等额本息前期利息占比高、本金摊还慢，缩短期限或提高月供: Total interest = monthly payment × periods − principal. With equal-installment repayment the early share of interest is high and principal amortizes slowly, so shortening the term or raising the payment cuts total interest markedly; equal-principal repayment has less total interest but higher early payments.

map.为什么总利息常接近甚至超过本金？: Why does total interest often approach or even exceed the principal?
map.长期低月供下，前期大部分月供用于付息，本金摊还慢，累计利息巨大。缩短期限或提高月: With long-term low payments, most of the early payment goes to interest and principal amortizes slowly, so accumulated interest is huge. Shortening the term or raising the payment cuts total interest markedly.
map.等额本金的总利息怎么算？: How is total interest computed for equal-principal repayment?
map.等额本金每月本金固定、利息递减，总利息=Σ(剩余本金×月利率)，比等额本息少，但: Equal-principal fixes monthly principal with decreasing interest; total interest = Σ(remaining principal × monthly rate), less than equal-installment but with higher early payments.
